card.name: Numbers in dosing intervals
card.fires_on: The digit that completes a number after 'every' in a dosing interval (every 8 hours, every 12 hours, every 6 weeks). Also fires on digits inside a decimal approximation in a math formula.

modes.label: Dosing interval digit
modes.description: The number right after 'every' that sets the gap between doses.
modes.example: (600 mg every <<8>> hours for four days)

modes.label: Decimal value in math
modes.description: Digits of an approximate value after the ≈ sign in a formula.

card.plain: It lights up on the number that says how many hours or weeks apart doses are given, and on digits in approximate math values.
